items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: He said, Mac, come to New York. You come to New York.

ctx.x: Yes. He said, Mac, come to New York. You come to New York. And that was 1914 when we went to New York. Yeah. And we were so scared, you know, that we were going to get fired, or canned, get the hook. You know, they had a hook that they would grab you. Oh, yeah, it is. Yeah. And the Whitman sisters, they were there with us. They were not there with us, but they were in New York.
